args:
Investigate and fix inconsistent outfit recommendation image format in                
  LooksInspiration component. Issue: Some outfit cards display mannequin-style images instead of flat-lay format. Expected behavior 
  per data/personas/prompt_gen/looks.md: 'flat-lay image with each item individually placed and separated, styled in an elegant     
  composition on a white background'. Root cause analysis needed: 1) Check apps/web/components/chat/LooksInspiration.tsx to         
  understand how outfit images are displayed 2) Check apps/web/components/chat/OutfitRecommendationCard.tsx for image source logic  
  3) Trace the image generation flow from apps/web/lib/services/image-generation-service.ts 4) Identify why some outfits use        
  mannequin images vs flat-lay format 5) Ensure all outfit recommendations consistently use AI-generated flat-lay images or         
  FlatLayComposite fallback, never mannequin product images

## Summary of the Investigation

The root cause of the inconsistent outfit image format is in **`OutfitRecommendationCard.tsx`** at lines 55-58:

```typescript
const flatLayImage = outfit.flatLayImageUrl || outfit.flatLayImageBase64
const fallbackImage = outfit.imageUrl  // <-- This is mannequin-style!
const displayImage = flatLayImage || fallbackImage
```

When AI flat-lay generation fails or is unavailable, the component falls back to `outfit.imageUrl`, which is a mannequin-style product thumbnail from the catalog. This violates the specification in `looks.md` that requires all outfit recommendations to display as flat-lay compositions.

The fix involves:
1. Using `FlatLayComposite` as an intermediate fallback instead of raw product thumbnails
2. The fallback priority becomes: AI flat-lay → CSS FlatLayComposite → (never mannequin images)
